metadata.title: Programme — Eco-Responsible Web Development
metadata.description: 42-hour intensive program: 7 days of European digital standards, AI-augmented engineering, performance architecture, SEO, and legal compliance. Lyon, France.

hero.label: International Training Program
hero.title: Web Development — European Standards & AI
hero.subtitle: A 42-hour intensive curriculum designed to transfer European digital expertise to international markets. Architecture, performance, SEO, legal compliance, and AI-augmented development.

vision.label: Vision & Impact
vision.title: Bridging The European Digital Gap
paragraphs: The European digital ecosystem operates under specific standards that combine performance, accessibility, legal compliance, and sustainability. These standards represent a competitive advantage that remains largely untransferred to emerging digital markets.

This program was designed to bridge that gap — offering a structured, intensive transfer of European web engineering practices to developers and teams building for international markets, with a particular focus on Uzbekistan's growing digital economy.

By combining institutional European methodologies with modern AI-augmented workflows, participants gain not just technical skills, but a strategic framework for building digital products that meet the highest international standards.

items.title: Master European Web Standards
items.description: Understand and implement the full stack of European digital requirements — from Core Web Vitals and accessibility to GDPR and legal compliance.

items.title: Build Performance-First Architecture
items.description: Design and deploy web applications using Next.js with SSR/SSG, optimized JavaScript, image pipelines, and edge-ready infrastructure.

items.title: Implement Production-Grade SEO
items.description: Deploy technical SEO at scale — metadata, structured data, sitemaps, Google Search Console integration, and local SEO strategies.

items.title: Ensure Legal Compliance
items.description: Implement GDPR-aligned legal pages, cookie consent management, privacy policies, and data processing frameworks.

items.title: Leverage AI in Development
items.description: Use AI tools for code generation, optimization, refactoring, and critical evaluation — integrating AI as a professional development accelerator.

items.title: Deliver a Production-Ready Project
items.description: Complete the program with a fully deployed, audited, and publicly presentable web project meeting European standards.

pedagogy.label: Pedagogical Approach
pedagogy.title: Learning Methodology
pedagogy.intro: The program follows a progressive, project-based methodology. Each day builds on the previous, culminating in a fully deployed production project.

principles.title: Project-Based Learning
principles.description: Every concept is immediately applied to a real project. No abstract exercises — only production-relevant implementation.

principles.title: Progressive Complexity
principles.description: The curriculum moves from foundational standards to advanced optimization, ensuring deep understanding at every level.

principles.title: European Institutional Rigor
principles.description: Content is structured to meet the expectations of European educational and professional institutions.

principles.title: AI-Augmented Workflow
principles.description: AI tools are integrated throughout — not as shortcuts, but as professional instruments requiring critical evaluation and expertise.

days.title: European Digital Standards & Market Evolution
topics: Digital sustainability and eco-responsible development principles
Core Web Vitals — LCP, FID, CLS — measurement and optimization targets
European legal expectations for digital products and services
Market gap analysis — European standards vs. emerging market practices

days.title: Architecture & Performance with Next.js
topics: Server-Side Rendering (SSR) and Static Site Generation (SSG) strategies
Performance-first architecture design and component optimization
JavaScript bundle optimization and code splitting techniques
Image optimization pipeline — formats, sizing, lazy loading, CDN delivery

days.title: Technical SEO Implementation
topics: Metadata architecture — title tags, meta descriptions, Open Graph protocol
Structured data implementation — JSON-LD, Schema.org vocabularies
Sitemap generation and robots.txt configuration
SEO-first content structure and semantic HTML architecture

days.title: Local SEO & Google Visibility
topics: Google Search Console setup, verification, and monitoring
Indexing strategies — request indexing, coverage reports, URL inspection
Error analysis — crawl errors, mobile usability, Core Web Vitals reports
LocalBusiness schema markup and geo-targeted optimization

days.title: Legal Compliance
topics: Mentions légales — legal notice requirements for European web properties
Privacy policy generation aligned with GDPR requirements
Cookie consent management — implementation and UX best practices
GDPR principles — data minimization, purpose limitation, user rights

days.title: AI-Augmented Development
topics: AI-assisted code generation — prompt engineering for development workflows
Performance optimization using AI-powered analysis tools
Code refactoring with AI — patterns, anti-patterns, and quality assurance
Critical evaluation of AI outputs — accuracy, security, and maintainability

days.title: Final Project & Deployment
topics: Full project deployment — production build, hosting, domain configuration
Lighthouse audit — achieving and maintaining scores above 95
SEO validation — Search Console submission by participants, indexing verification
Public presentation — project defense and professional demonstration

modules.title: Architecture & Performance
modules.description: Modern web architecture using Next.js App Router with performance-first design principles.
items: Next.js App Router — layouts, routes, server components
SSR / SSG rendering strategies and hydration
Bundle analysis and JavaScript optimization
Image optimization and asset delivery pipelines
Core Web Vitals monitoring and optimization
Edge deployment and CDN configuration

modules.title: SEO Engineering
modules.description: Technical SEO implementation at production scale.
items: Metadata architecture and Open Graph protocol
JSON-LD structured data — Article, Organization, LocalBusiness
Dynamic sitemap and robots.txt generation
Google Search Console integration and monitoring
Crawl budget optimization and indexing strategies
Rich results and SERP feature targeting

modules.title: Legal & Compliance
modules.description: European legal framework implementation for digital products.
items: GDPR principles and data processing requirements
Legal notice (mentions légales) generation
Privacy policy aligned with EU regulations
Cookie consent — technical implementation and UX
Data processing agreements and third-party compliance
Accessibility requirements under EU Accessibility Act

modules.title: AI Integration
modules.description: Professional AI tools integration across the development lifecycle.
items: AI-assisted code generation and prompt engineering
Performance analysis with AI-powered tools
Automated code review and refactoring
AI-generated content evaluation and quality control
Ethical AI usage in professional development
Limitations and risk assessment of AI outputs

uzbekistan.label: International Impact
uzbekistan.title: Impact for Uzbekistan
uzbekistan.intro: Uzbekistan's digital market is experiencing rapid growth. This program is specifically designed to accelerate the transfer of European digital standards to Uzbek developers and organisations.

points.title: Standard Transfer
points.description: Direct transfer of European web engineering standards — performance, SEO, accessibility, and legal compliance — to Uzbekistan's growing digital industry.

points.title: Competitive Advantage
points.description: Participants gain a competitive edge by mastering standards that are increasingly required for international projects and European market access.

points.title: Certificate of Participation
points.description: The program grants a certificate of participation, validating exposure to European-standard competencies for Uzbek professionals.

points.title: Institutional Partnership
points.description: Building long-term institutional partnerships between French and Uzbek educational and professional organisations.

outcomes.label: Concrete Outcomes
outcomes.title: What Participants Deliver
items: A fully deployed production website meeting European standards
Lighthouse performance score ≥ 95 across all metrics
Complete technical SEO implementation with Google indexing
Legal compliance — GDPR-aligned privacy policy, cookie consent, legal notices
Structured data implementation with rich result eligibility
AI-augmented development workflow integration
Professional project presentation and defense

closing.label: Programme Conclusion
closing.title: A European Standard for the World
closing.description: This program represents more than a training course. It is a structured transfer of European digital engineering excellence — designed for professionals who build for international standards, powered by AI, and validated by production deployment.
